reason: I'm not putting a vendor with no SOC 2 report, no customers and no references inline in our trade path, even for free. Our engineers already rate-limit every key and our terms already put agent risk on the customer, so I don't feel the pain hard enough to take that risk.
objection: A pre-audit startup proxy sitting in front of every agent trade is a new single point of failure and a security review I can't pass. If it goes down or gets breached, it's my outage and my regulator conversation, not theirs.
would_change_my_mind: A finished SOC 2 Type II report plus two or three reference customers at brokers our size running it in production, or a regulator explicitly telling us we need agent-level controls and audit evidence beyond our terms.
